label: Complex analytic spaces
rationale: The current Stacks tree intentionally has no general category of complex analytic spaces.

label: Analytification
rationale: Only bounded analytification comparisons are present.

label: Coherent sheaves
rationale: The algebraic coherent-sheaf infrastructure is explicit.

label: Proper and projective morphisms
rationale: Proper and projective morphisms are developed algebraically.

label: GAGA cohomology comparison
rationale: No general complex-analytic cohomology comparison theorem is currently present.

label: GAGA coherent-sheaf comparison
rationale: The analytic coherent-sheaf equivalence is outside the current foundations.

label: Flatness
rationale: Flatness and Tor criteria are developed directly.

label: Formal comparison
rationale: Formal functions and algebraization provide algebraic analogues but not analytic GAGA itself.

label: Invertible sheaves
rationale: Invertible modules and their first-cohomology classification are explicit.
